result.description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes calls (Zoom/Meet/Teams) and extracts action items.
result.auth_detail: Per-user API key (X-Api-Key header) generated in User Settings > API Access; OAuth2 (Bearer) for public multi-user apps, registered via self-serve marketplace app form.
result.access_detail: API keys and webhooks included on all plans, including free. Each end user can self-generate their own key, so no review gate. OAuth app registration is self-serve (2 min); review mentioned applies to marketplace promotion/listing, docs not stating review blocks other users connecting. Minor uncertainty on OAuth review.
result.api_notes: Base https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1. About 12 endpoints: list meetings, meeting types, recording summary/transcript (sync or async via destination_url), request/get download, teams, team members, users, create/delete webhook. Official TypeScript and Python SDKs. OAuth apps cannot use include_summary/include_transcript on /meetings; must use /recordings endpoints.
